verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a cloud platform, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question and the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows infrastructure for hosting third-party agents such as Claude Code and Codex in Sprites, plus an experimental flyctl MCP server that exposes tools to external clients. Neither is a native assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
